templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from hub-spoke by the note-writer: this is a 4-component trust-dependency mesh (Microvium depends directly on all three of Switcher, Allocator and Scheduler) with no single coordinator, closer to dataflow-dag than to hub-spoke.
templates.what_to_learn: The transferable lesson is a small trust/dependency graph, not hub-spoke: colour each node by its one narrow privilege, number each node to a legend entry below stating exactly what it is trusted for, and let a non-trusted example component (Microvium) hang off the graph to show what depending on the TCB looks like.
